text: That’s me in the park photo I’ve attached, and I’d like you to put my face on the astronaut in the attached poster. I thought this would be a fun way to imagine myself in one of those old space posters. What I mean is to replace the astronaut’s visible face with mine from the park pic, keeping the vertical 9:16 poster shape, and a free-tier size is fine. Please keep the original suit, helmet, stars in the background and retro poster look. I’m a little worried about losing the charm of the original poster in the process. Please don’t add any text.
